name: sychov-igaming-skills

plugins.name: watch-igaming

plugins.name: second-deposit-igaming
plugins.description: Shows why first-time depositors do not make a second deposit, from casino back-office exports: 12 reasons, missing second deposits and Sum Dep per reason, 24 metrics and a daily list for the CRM. Local python3 scripts, player rows stay on your machine.

plugins.name: show-igaming
